# Medicine Brand Finder

> Find the brand names of a medicine's active ingredient in other countries. Results come from official medicines databases (EU EMA, France, Italy, Poland, Netherlands, Ireland, Switzerland, Czech Republic, Denmark, Canada, Spain), open references (RxNorm, openFDA, Wikidata, PubChem) and optional AI suggestions; every result is labelled with its source. Demo, not medical advice. Free software, GPL-3.0-or-later.

- Live: https://medicine-finder.up.railway.app/
- Source: https://github.com/andreibesleaga/medicine-finder
- Result types: official (regulator data), reference (open reference data), curated (static sample lists, not from a regulator), ai (model suggestion, unverified).

## API

- [API reference](https://github.com/andreibesleaga/medicine-finder/blob/main/docs/API.md): GET /api/search?q=<ingredient>&country=<country> (official data), GET /api/ai (AI suggestions), GET /api/sources (source status), GET /api/health. JSON, rate-limited, no key needed.
